title: erigeron compositus var. breviradiatus
intro: Erigeron compositus var. breviradiatus, commonly known as Short-stemmed Fleabane, is a plant species in the daisy family, characterized by its compact growth and small white or pink flowers. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Erigeron compositus var. breviradiatus are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
